title: Department of Engineering Announces Northbound Lane Closure
summary: The City of Syracuse Department of Engineering announced a northbound lane closure on East Brighton Avenue between Ainsley Drive and Thurber Street beginning September 14, 2026, as part of the East Brighton Avenue reconstruction project. The closure is expected to last through October 31, 2026, with southbound traffic remaining open and northbound traffic detoured via Ainsley Drive, Jamesville Avenue, and Thurber Street.
